paragraphs: Roper Technologies, Inc. ("Roper," the "Company," "we," "our," or "us") is a diversified technology company. Roper has a proven, long-term, successful track record of compounding cash flow and increasing shareholder value. We operate market leading businesses that design and develop vertical software and technology enabled products for a variety of defensible niche markets.

We pursue consistent and sustainable growth in revenue, earnings, and cash flow by enabling continuous improvement in the operating performance of our businesses and by acquiring businesses that offer high value-added software, services, technology-enabled products, and solutions that we believe are capable of realizing growth while maintaining high margins. We compete in many defensible niche markets and believe we are the market leader or a competitive alternative to the market leader in most of these markets.

In the last three years, we have deployed approximately $8,960 of capital toward acquisitions. In 2025, this included approximately $1,850 for the acquisition of CentralReach, a leading provider of Software-as-a-Service ("SaaS") and AI-enabled solutions for applied behavior analysis ("ABA") therapy clinicians, and approximately $800 for the acquisition of Subsplash, a leading provider of AI-enabled SaaS, and integrated giving solutions, for faith-based organizations. In 2024, this included approximately $1,860 for the acquisition of Procare, a leading provider of SaaS solutions and integrated payment processing for early childhood education centers, and approximately $1,600 for the acquisition of Transact Campus, a leading provider of integrated campus technology and payment solutions serving higher education, healthcare, and business campuses, which was combined with our CBORD business. In 2023, this included approximately $1,380 for the acquisition of Syntellis, a leading provider of SaaS solutions for healthcare, financial institution, and higher education providers, which was combined with our Strata business. Additionally, we deployed approximately $1,470 toward other bolt-on acquisitions to help build on the strategic position of several of our businesses.

In November 2022, Roper completed the divestiture of a majority equity stake in its industrial businesses, including its entire historical Process Technologies reportable segment and the industrial businesses within its historical Measurement & Analytical Solutions reportable segment (collectively "Indicor"), to Clayton, Dubilier & Rice, LLC ("CD&R"). Following the sale of the majority stake, Roper retained a minority equity interest in Indicor. See Note 9 of the Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements included in this Annual Report for additional information regarding Roper's minority equity interest in Indicor.
The financial results of Indicor are reported as discontinued operations for all periods presented. Unless otherwise noted, discussion within Part I relates to continuing operations.
We were incorporated on December 17, 1981 under the laws of the State of Delaware.

Leadership with Technology and Products for Niche Markets – We maintain a leading position in many of our markets. We believe our market positions are attributable to the applications expertise used to create high value products and solutions for our customers, the underlying critical nature of our offerings, and the inherent customer intimacy of our chosen niche markets. Our businesses realize growth from new and existing customers in their niche markets through successfully executing go-to-market strategies, developing new products and applications, and delivering professional services. Increasingly, this includes AI-enabled products and functionality embedded within customers' mission-critical workflows. By leveraging our deep domain expertise, proprietary data, and long-standing customer relationships, we believe these AI capabilities enhance product differentiation, and drive incremental automation and improved customer outcomes which support expanded monetization opportunities.

Diversified End Markets and Geographic Reach – We have a global presence, with sales to customers outside of the U.S. totaling $1,029.7 in 2025. Information regarding our international operations is set forth in Note 14 of the Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements included in this Annual Report.

Our Application Software segment had net revenues of $4,483.0 for the year ended December 31, 2025, representing 56.7% of our total net revenues. Below is a description of the products offered by businesses that comprise the Application Software segment:

Aderant – comprehensive management software and AI-enabled solutions for law and other professional services firms, including business development, calendar/docket matter management, time and billing, and case management.
CentralReach – SaaS and AI-enabled solutions enabling the workflow and administration of ABA therapy for autism spectrum disorder ("ASD") and related disabilities care.
Clinisys – diagnostic and laboratory information management software solutions.

headings: Risks Related to Our Business Operations
Our growth strategy includes acquisitions. We may not be able to identify suitable acquisition candidates, complete acquisitions, or integrate acquisitions successfully.
Our technology is important to our success, and our failure to protect this technology could put us at a competitive disadvantage.
We use AI in our business, and challenges with properly managing its use could result in reputational harm, competitive harm, and legal liability, and adversely affect our results of operations.
Product liability, insurance risks, product recalls, and increased insurance costs could harm our operating results.
Our operating results could be adversely affected by a reduction in business with our large customers.
Unfavorable changes in foreign exchange rates may harm our business.
We face intense competition. If we do not compete effectively, our business may suffer.
Our indebtedness may affect our business and may restrict our operating flexibility.
Our goodwill and other intangible assets are a significant amount of our total assets, and any write-off of our intangible assets would negatively affect our results of operations.
We depend on our ability to develop new products and software, and any failure to develop or market new products and software could adversely affect our business.
Changes in the supply of, or price for, raw materials, parts, and components used in our products, or third-party services used in the delivery of our SaaS solutions could affect our business.
Our non-operating results may be adversely impacted by the performance of Indicor, in which we own a minority interest.
Divestitures or other dispositions could negatively impact our business.
Risks Related to Government Regulations
Regulation of privacy and data security may adversely affect sales of our products and services and result in increased compliance costs.
Regulation limiting or controlling the use of AI may restrict our ability to use AI, our ability to create new products, and create increased compliance costs.
Expectations relating to sustainability considerations expose the Company to potential liabilities, increased costs, reputational harm, and other adverse effects on the Company's business.
Risks Related to Economic and Political Conditions
Economic, political, and other risks associated with our international operations could adversely affect our business.
Political and geopolitical conditions can adversely affect our business.
General Risk Factors
The potential insolvency or financial distress of third parties could adversely impact our business and results of operations.
Changes to our executive leadership team and any future loss of members of such team, and the resulting management transitions, could harm our operating results.
Legal proceedings to which we are, or may be, a party may adversely affect us.
A downgrade in the ratings of our debt could restrict our ability to access the debt capital markets and increase our interest costs.
paragraphs: Our future rate of growth is highly dependent on our ability to acquire and successfully integrate new businesses. We intend to seek additional acquisition opportunities, both to expand into new markets and to enhance our position in existing markets. There are no assurances, however, that we will be able to successfully identify suitable candidates, negotiate appropriate terms, obtain financing on acceptable terms, complete proposed acquisitions, receive the necessary regulatory approvals (including clearance under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Act in the U.S. and similar antitrust regulations in foreign countries), successfully integrate acquired businesses, or expand into new markets. Once acquired, operations may not achieve anticipated levels of revenues, profitability, or cash flows.

Acquisitions involve risks, including difficulties in the integration of the operations, technologies, services, and products of the acquired companies and the diversion of management's attention from other business concerns. Although our management will endeavor to evaluate the risks inherent in any particular transaction, including but not limited to cybersecurity risks and susceptibility to market disruption from AI or otherwise, there are no assurances that we will properly ascertain all such risks. Acquisitions may involve significant cash expenditures, debt incurrences, equity issuances, and expenses. Difficulties encountered with acquisitions may have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, and results of operations.

Many of our products and services rely on proprietary technology; therefore, we believe that the development and protection of intellectual property rights through patents, copyrights, trade secrets, trademarks, confidentiality agreements, and other contractual provisions are important to the future success of our business. Despite our efforts to protect proprietary rights, unauthorized parties or competitors may copy or otherwise obtain and use our products or technology, including through misappropriation through contractors or other third parties. Actions to enforce these rights may result in substantial costs and diversion of resources, and we make no assurances that any such actions will be successful, particularly given evolving uncertainty regarding protection and ownership of AI-assisted outputs.

We rely on information and technology, including third-party cloud computing platforms and other third-party business partners, for many of our business operations which could fail and cause disruption to our business operations.

Our business operations are dependent upon information technology networks and systems to securely transmit, process, and store information and to communicate among our locations around the world and with clients, suppliers, and business partners. A shutdown of, or inability to access, one or more of our facilities, a power outage, or a failure of one or more of our information technology, telecommunications, or other systems could significantly impair our ability to perform such functions on a timely basis. Our compliance, cybersecurity and data privacy programs, cybersecurity technology, and risk management cannot eliminate all system risk. Credential compromise and identity-based attacks represent risks, and while we deploy identity threat protection and multi-factor authentication across our enterprise systems, determined attackers may still gain unauthorized access through sophisticated credential theft, session hijacking, social engineering, or privilege escalation techniques. Cybersecurity incidents including ransomware attacks, insider threats, system disruptions, and configuration errors could result in the misappropriation or corruption of data and assets, or disruptions to our business strategy, results of operations, and financial condition, and may require notification to customers and regulators with associated investigation, remediation, and monitoring obligations. These disruptions may include, but are not limited to, interruptions to business operations, loss of intellectual property, release of confidential information, alteration or corruption of data or systems, costs related to remediation or the payment of ransom, litigation (including individual claims, consumer class actions, or commercial litigation), administrative, civil, or criminal investigations or actions, regulatory intervention and sanctions or fines, investigation and remediation costs, and prolonged negative publicity. While we have experienced disruptions, and our Vertafore business was previously subject to litigation regarding the exposure of data which was dismissed, none of these matters had a significant impact on our business.

We rely on business partners such as third-party data centers and cloud platforms, such as Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud Platform, Microsoft Azure, and Oracle Cloud to host certain enterprise and customer systems. Our software development and business operations rely on open-source components, third-party software libraries, and vendor dependencies that could contain undisclosed vulnerabilities, be subject to supply chain attacks, or become unavailable, potentially affecting our products, hosted services, and internal systems. Our ability to monitor such third parties' security measures and the full impact of the systemic risk is limited, and concentration with a limited number of providers increases exposure to outages and pricing changes. If any third-party system or cloud platform that we use is unavailable to us for any reason, our customers may experience service interruptions, which could significantly impact our operations, reputation, business, and financial results. Failure of our systems or those of our third-party service providers, may result in interruptions in our service and loss of data or processing capabilities, all of which may cause a loss in customers, refunds of product fees, and/or material harm to our reputation and operating results. While certain of our businesses have experienced temporary disruptions, their impact has been limited and did not have a significant impact on our businesses.

We operate market leading businesses that design and develop vertical software and technology enabled products for a variety of defensible niche markets.

We pursue consistent and sustainable growth in revenue, earnings, and cash flow by enabling continuous improvement in the operating performance of our existing businesses and by acquiring businesses that offer high value-added software, services, technology-enabled products, and solutions that we believe are capable of realizing growth while maintaining high margins.

In November 2022, Roper completed the divestiture of a majority equity stake in its industrial businesses, including its entire historical Process Technologies reportable segment and the industrial businesses within its historical Measurement & Analytical Solutions reportable segment (collectively "Indicor"), to CD&R. Following the sale of the majority equity stake, Roper retained a minority equity interest in Indicor. See Note 9 of the Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements included in this Annual Report for additional information regarding Roper's minority equity interest in Indicor.

Our Consolidated Financial Statements are prepared in conformity with generally accepted accounting principles in the United States ("GAAP"). A discussion of our significant accounting policies can also be found in the Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements for the year ended December 31, 2025 included in this Annual Report.

GAAP offers acceptable alternative methods for accounting for certain issues affecting our financial results, such as determining inventory cost, depreciating long-lived assets, and recognizing revenue. Other than the changes during 2023 as further described in Note 9 of our Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements with respect to the methodology used to value our equity investment in Indicor, we have not changed the application of acceptable accounting methods or the significant estimates affecting the application of these principles in the last three years in a manner that had a material effect on our Consolidated Financial Statements.

The preparation of financial statements in accordance with GAAP requires the use of estimates, assumptions, judgments, and interpretations that can affect the reported amounts of assets, liabilities, revenues and expenses, the disclosure of contingent assets and liabilities, and other supplemental disclosures.

The development of accounting estimates is the responsibility of our management. Our management discusses those areas that require significant judgments with the Audit Committee of our Board of Directors. The Audit Committee has reviewed all financial disclosures in our annual filings with the SEC. Although we believe the positions we have taken with regard to uncertainties are reasonable, others might reach different conclusions and our positions can change over time as more information becomes available. If an accounting estimate changes, its effects are accounted for prospectively or through a cumulative catch-up adjustment.

Our most significant accounting uncertainties are encountered in the areas of income taxes, valuation of other intangible assets, goodwill and other indefinite-lived intangibles impairment analyses, and valuation of our equity investment in Indicor. Estimates are considered to be significant if they meet both of the following criteria: (1) the estimate requires assumptions about matters that are uncertain at the time the estimate is made, and (2) changes in the estimate are reasonably likely to have a material financial impact from period-to-period.

Income taxes can be affected by estimates of whether and within which jurisdictions future earnings will occur and if, how, and when cash is repatriated to the U.S., combined with other aspects of an overall income tax strategy. Additionally, taxing jurisdictions could retroactively disagree with our tax treatment of certain items, and some historical transactions have income tax effects going forward. Accounting rules require these future effects to be evaluated using current laws, rules and regulations, each of which can change at any time and in an unpredictable manner. If there is a material change in the actual effective tax rates, the time period within which the underlying temporary differences become taxable or deductible, or if the tax law changes are unfavorable, there could be a resulting increase to income tax expense and the effective tax rate.
Our 2025 effective income tax rate was 20.6% and our 2024 effective income tax rate was 21.2%. We expect the effective tax rate for 2026 to be approximately 21% to 22%.

paragraphs: Roper Technologies, Inc. ("Roper," the "Company," "we," "our," or "us") 為一間多元化科技公司。Roper 有著長期成功的紀錄，能持續增加現金流與股東價值。我們經營著市場領先的業務，這些業務設計並開發垂直軟體與科技驅動的產品，應用於多種可防禦的專業市場。
我們追求穩定且可持續的成長，包括營業收入、獲利與現金流，透過持續改善我們業務的營運表現，並收購提供高附加價值軟體、服務、科技驅動產品與解決方案的企業，我們相信這些企業能實現成長同時維持高毛利率。我們競爭於許多可防禦的專業市場，並相信我們在大多數這些市場中為市場領導者或與市場領導者競爭的替代方案。

在過去三年，我們投入約 $8,960 的資本進行收購。2025 年，這包括約 $1,850 用於收購 CentralReach，這是一家提供軟體即服務（"SaaS"）與 AI 驅動解決方案的領導者，專門服務應用行為分析（"ABA"）治療師；以及約 $800 用於收購 Subsplash，這是一家提供 AI 驅動 SaaS 與整合型捐贈解決方案的領導者，服務基於信仰的組織。2024 年，這包括約 $1,860 用於收購 Procare，這是一家提供 SaaS 解決方案與整合型付款處理服務的領導者，服務早期兒童教育中心；以及約 $1,600 用於收購 Transact Campus，這是一家提供整合型校園科技與付款解決方案的領導者，服務高等教育、醫療與企業校園，並與我們的 CBORD 事業合併。2023 年，這包括約 $1,380 用於收購 Syntellis，這是一家提供 SaaS 解決方案的領導者，服務醫療機構、金融機構與高等教育機構，並與我們的 Strata 事業合併。此外，我們還投入約 $1,470 用於其他補強型收購，以協助強化我們幾個業務的戰略地位。

2022 年 11 月，Roper 完成將其工業業務的多數股權出售給 Clayton, Dubilier & Rice, LLC（"CD&R"）。這包括其歷史 Process Technologies 應報告分部與歷史 Measurement & Analytical Solutions 應報告分部內的工業業務（合稱 "Indicor"）。出售多數股權後，Roper 仍保留 Indicor 的少數股權。有關 Roper 在 Indicor 的少數股權，請參閱本年度報告所附財務會計摘要的第九節附註。
Indicor 的財務結果在所有期間均被列為已終止業務。除非另有說明，Part I 中的討論均與持續經營業務相關。
我們於 1981 年 12 月 17 日根據特拉華州法律成立。

以科技與產品領導專業市場 – 我們在許多市場中維持領先地位。我們相信我們的市場地位歸因於用於創造高價值產品與解決方案的應用專業知識、我們產品的關鍵性，以及我們所選擇的專業市場內的內在客戶親近性。我們的業務透過成功執行市場進入策略、開發新產品與應用程式，以及提供專業服務，從新舊客戶中實現成長。越來越常見的是，這包括 AI 驅動的產品與功能，嵌入於客戶的關鍵業務流程中。透過運用我們深厚的領域專業知識、專利資料與長期的客戶關係，我們相信這些 AI 能力能提升產品差異化，並驅動額外的自動化與改善客戶成果，從而支持擴展的獲利機會。
多元化的終端市場與地理覆蓋 – 我們在全球擁有業務，2025 年對美國以外客戶的銷售總計為 $1,029.7。有關我們國際業務的資訊，請參閱本年度報告所附財務會計摘要的第十四節附註。
Roper 的應報告分部結構係根據商業模式及履行績效義務的方式來劃分。本公司有三個應報告分部，如下所述：

本公司應用軟體分部於 2025 年 12 月 31 日會計年度之淨銷售額為 4,483.0 美元，佔本公司總淨銷售額的 56.7%。以下為組成應用軟體分部之企業所提供的產品說明：
Aderant – 提供法律及其他專業服務機構之綜合管理軟體及 AI 服務解決方案，包括業務開發、行事曆/當事人管理、時間與計費，以及案例管理。
CentralReach – 提供 SaaS 及 AI 服務解決方案，用以支援自閉症譜系障礙（"ASD"）及其他相關障礙之 ABA 治療作業流程與行政管理。
Clinisys – 提供診斷及實驗室資訊管理軟體解決方案。

2022 年 11 月，Roper 完成將其工業業務的多數股權出售，包括其歷史 Process Technologies 應報告分部與歷史 Measurement & Analytical Solutions 應報告分部內的工業業務（合稱 "Indicor"），出售給 CD&R。出售多數股權後，Roper 仍持有 Indicor 的少數股權。有關 Roper 對 Indicor 的少數股權，請參閱本年度報告所附的財務會計摘要註釋第 9 項。

有關本公司應報告分部的財務資訊，請參閱本年度報告所附財務會計摘要註釋第 14 項。
本公司合併財務報表係依照美國通用會計準則 ("GAAP") 會計準則編製。有關本公司重要會計政策的討論，請參閱本年度報告所附財務會計摘要註釋，財務年度為 2025 年 12 月 31 日。

GAAP 提供可接受的替代方法，用以會計處理某些影響我們財務結果的問題，例如決定存貨成本、 depreciating 長壽命資產，以及確認營業收入。除了 2023 年的變動，如進一步說明於我們合併財務會計明細表的附註 9 中，關於用以評估我們在 Indicor 的權益投資價值的方法外，我們未改變可接受會計方法的應用或影響這些原則應用的重大估計，在最近三年內的變動方式不會對我們的合併財務會計表產生重大影響。
根據 GAAP 編製財務會計表需要使用估計、假設、判斷與解釋，這些會影響所報告的資產、負債、收入與費用金額，以及對或有資產與負債的揭露，以及其他補充性揭露。
會計估計的發展是我們管理階層的責任。我們管理階層會與董事會審計委員會討論那些需要重大判斷的領域。審計委員會已審閱我們年度向 SEC 檔案中所有財務揭露。雖然我們認為我們對不確定性所採取的立場是合理的，但其他人可能得出不同的結論，而我們的立場也可能隨著更多資訊的取得而改變。如果會計估計發生變動，其影響會透過前瞻性處理或累計調整方式進行會計處理。
我們最重大的會計不確定性出現在收入稅、其他無形資產的評估、商譽及其他無限期無形資產減損分析，以及我們在 Indicor 的權益投資評估這些領域。估計被認為是重大的，如果其符合以下兩項標準：(1) 估計需要在估計時對不確定的事項做出假設，以及 (2) 估計的變動合理可能對期與期之間產生重大財務影響。

收入稅可能受到對未來收益是否發生以及在哪些管轄地區發生的估計，以及是否、如何、何時將現金匯回美國的影響，並結合整體收入稅策略的其他方面。此外，稅務管轄地區可能對某些項目我們的稅務處理方式進行追溯性不同意，且一些歷史交易對未來會產生收入稅影響。會計規則要求使用現行法律、規則與法規評估這些未來影響，而這些法律、規則與法規隨時都可能改變，且改變方式難以預測。如果實際有效稅率發生重大變動，或影響基礎臨時差異成為應稅或扣除的期間，或如果稅法變動不利，可能會導致收入稅費用與有效稅率增加。
我們 2025 年的有效收入稅率為 20.6%，2024 年的有效收入稅率為 21.2%。我們預期 2026 年的有效稅率約為 21% 到 22%。

headings: 與我們業務運作相關的風險
我們的成長策略包括收購。我們可能無法識別合適的收購對象、完成收購或成功整合收購。
我們的技術對我們的成功至關重要，若我們無法保護此技術，可能會使我們處於競爭劣勢。
我們在業務中使用人工智能，若在管理其使用方面遇到困難，可能會導致聲譽損害、競爭損害及法律責任，並不利於我們的營運結果。
產品責任、保險風險、產品回收及保險成本增加可能會損害我們的營運結果。
我們的營運結果可能因與大型客戶的業務減少而受到不利影響。
外幣匯率的不利變動可能損害我們的業務。
我們面臨激烈的競爭。若我們無法有效競爭，我們的業務可能會受影響。
本公司負債可能影響業務，並可能限制營運彈性。
本公司 goodwill 及其他無形資產佔總資產相當大比例，若發生無形資產減損，將對營運成果產生負面影響。
本公司依賴開發新產品及軟體的能力，若無法開發或推廣新產品及軟體，將對業務產生負面影響。
用於產品之原材料、零件及零組件供應量或價格，或用於交付 SaaS 解決方案之第三方服務變動，可能影響業務。
本公司非營運成果可能受 Indicor 表現影響，而 Indicor 為本公司持有少數股權之公司。
資產處分或其它處分可能對業務產生負面影響。
與政府規範相關之風險
隱私權及資料安全之規範可能影響本公司產品及服務之銷售，並導致合規成本增加。
規範限制或控制 AI 使用的規則可能限制本公司使用 AI 的能力、創造新產品的能力，並增加合規成本。
與永續性相關的預期可能使本公司面臨潛在的責任、增加成本、聲譽損害，以及其他對本公司業務的不利影響。
與經濟及政治條件相關的風險
與本公司國際業務相關的經濟、政治及其他風險可能對本公司業務產生不利影響。
政治與地緣政治條件可能對本公司業務產生不利影響。
一般風險因素
第三方潛在破產或財務困難可能對本公司業務及營運成果產生不利影響。
本公司高層管理團隊的變動及未來可能失去該團隊成員，以及由此產生的管理轉換，可能損害本公司營運成果。
本公司可能涉及或可能涉及的法律訴訟可能對本公司產生不利影響。
本公司債務評級 downgrade 可能限制本公司取得債務資本市場融資的能力，並提高本公司利息成本。
paragraphs: 本公司未來的成長速度高度依賴於本公司能否取得並成功整合新業務。本公司有意尋求額外的收購機會，以擴展至新市場並強化在現有市場的競爭地位。然而，無法保證本公司能成功識別合適的目標、協商適當的條款、取得可接受的融資、完成預期的收購、取得必要的監管批准（包括美國的哈特-斯科特-羅德諾法案核准以及外國的類似反壟斷法規）、成功整合收購的業務，或擴展至新市場。一旦收購完成，其營運可能無法達到預期的收入、利潤或現金流水平。
收購涉及風險，包括整合收購公司之營運、技術、服務及產品的困難，以及管理層對其他業務事務的注意力被分散。儘管本公司管理層會努力評估任何特定交易內在的風險，包括但不限於網路安全風險及因人工智慧或其他因素導致市場中斷的風險，但無法保證本公司能正確識別所有這些風險。收購可能涉及重大現金支出、負債增加、發行股票及費用。在收購過程中遇到的困難可能對本公司業務、財務狀況及營運成果造成重大不利影響。

許多本公司產品及服務依賴專利技術；因此，我們認為透過專利、著作權、商業機密、商標、保密協議及其他契約條款來發展及保護智慧財產權，對本公司未來業務的成功至關重要。儘管我們努力保護專利權，但未經授權的個人或競爭對手仍可能複製或以其他方式取得並使用本公司產品或技術，包括透過承包商或其他第三方的侵佔行為。執行這些權利的行動可能導致重大成本及資源的分散，我們無法保證任何此類行動會成功，特別是在有關人工智慧輔助輸出的保護與所有權的演進不確定性方面。
本公司依賴資訊與科技，包括第三方雲端計算平台及其他第三方商業夥伴，來執行許多業務運作，這些運作可能失敗並導致業務運作中斷。

本公司業務運作依賴資訊科技網路與系統，以安全地傳送、處理及儲存資訊，並與全球各地的營運據點、客戶、供應商及商業夥伴進行溝通。若某個營運據點關閉，或無法存取，或發生電力中斷，或資訊科技、電信業者或其他系統的故障，將嚴重影響本公司及時執行這些功能的能力。本公司合規、網路安全及資料隱私方案、網路安全科技及風險管理無法消除所有系統風險。憑證遭竊取及基於身分的攻擊代表風險，儘管我們在企業系統中部署身分威脅防護及多重驗證，但決心強的攻擊者仍可能透過高階憑證竊取、會話劫持、社會工程或權限提升技術取得未經授權的存取。網路安全事件包括勒索軟體攻擊、內部威脅、系統中斷及設定錯誤，可能導致資料或資產遭竊取或破壞，或對本公司業務策略、營運成果及財務狀況造成中斷，並可能需要通知客戶及監管機構，並伴隨調查、修復及監測義務。這些中斷可能包括但不限於業務運作中斷、智慧財產權流失、機密資訊外洩、資料或系統的變更或破壞、修復相關成本或支付贖金、訴訟（包括個人聲請、消費者羣體訴訟或商業訴訟）、行政、民事或刑事調查或行動、監管幹預及處罰或罰款、調查及修復成本，以及長期負面宣傳。儘管我們曾經驗過中斷，且本公司Vertafore業務先前曾因資料外洩遭起訴，但這些事項對本公司業務的影響並未顯著。

本公司依賴商業夥伴，如第三方資料中心及雲端平台，例如Amazon Web Services、Google Cloud Platform、Microsoft Azure及Oracle Cloud，來主機部分企業及客戶系統。本公司軟體開發及業務運作依賴開放原始碼零組件、第三方軟體庫及供應商依賴，這些可能包含未披露的漏洞、遭受供應鏈攻擊，或變得不可用，可能影響本公司產品、主機服務及內部系統。本公司監測這些第三方安全措施及系統風險全面影響的能力有限，與有限數量供應商的集中度增加對中斷及價格變動的風險。若任何本公司使用的第三方系統或雲端平台因任何原因無法使用，客戶可能遭遇服務中斷，這可能對本公司運作、聲譽、業務及財務結果造成重大影響。本公司系統或第三方服務供應商系統的失敗，可能導致服務中斷及資料或處理能力的喪失，所有這些都可能導致客戶流失、產品費用退款，以及對本公司聲譽及營運成果造成重大損害。儘管某些業務曾經驗過暫時中斷，但其影響有限，且未對本公司業務造成顯著影響。
